item.title: CC Switch Launches as Cross-Platform Manager for AI Coding Agents
item.description:
CC Switch Launches as Cross-Platform Manager for AI Coding Agents

CC Switch is a newly released cross-platform desktop manager designed to configure and switch between various AI coding agents and tools. Built with Tauri 2, it supports Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.

🔍 Overview

CC Switch serves as an all-in-one manager for a variety of agentic tools and models, including:

Tool Description
Claude Code AI coding assistant
Claude Desktop AI desktop application
Codex Coding agent
Gemini CLI Command line interface
Grok Build Development build tool
OpenCode Coding tool
OpenClaw Coding agent
Hermes Agent Agentic tool

⚙️ Key Details

CC Switch facilitates integration with Kimi K3, Moonshot AI’s model with 2.8 trillion parameters, native vision, and a 1-million-token context window. The manager also supports integration with several API relay service providers:

  • PackyCode: Provides relay services for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and others. Users can use promo code “cc-switch” during their first recharge for a 10% discount.
  • ZetaAPI: Focuses on model fidelity and offers pay-as-you-go billing with a 10x compensation guarantee for quality inconsistencies. Users can use promo code “CC-SWITCH” for a 10% discount on the first top-up.
  • APINEBULA: An enterprise-grade aggregation platform that provides access to Claude, GPT, and Gemini models. Users can use promo code “ccswitch” for a 10% discount on the first recharge.

🚀 Availability

CC Switch is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. The official website for the application is ccswitch.io.

item.title: Claude Code: AI Coding Assistant Launched for Terminal and IDE
item.description:
Claude Code: AI Coding Assistant Launched for Terminal and IDE

Anthropic has released Claude Code, an agentic coding tool designed to accelerate development workflows. The tool integrates directly into terminals, IDEs, or GitHub via natural language commands.

🔍 Overview

Claude Code understands your codebase to automate routine tasks, explain complex code, and manage git workflows. It operates through natural language instructions in your terminal or IDE, with GitHub integration via @claude mentions.

🧩 Key Features

  • Execute routine coding tasks via natural language
  • Explain complex code sections
  • Handle git workflows through commands
  • Report issues using /bug command
  • Extend functionality via custom plugins

⚙️ Installation

Installation methods include:

Platform Command
MacOS/Linux `curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh
Homebrew brew install --cask claude-code
Windows `irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1
WinGet winget install Anthropic.ClaudeCode
NPM (Deprecated) npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code (deprecated)

Post-installation: Navigate to your project directory and run claude.

🛠️ Plugins

The tool supports plugins that add custom commands and agents. See the plugins directory for documentation on available extensions.

⚖️ Feedback & Privacy

Claude Code collects usage data (code acceptance/rejection, conversation data, and /bug feedback) to improve the tool. Safeguards include:

  • Limited retention of sensitive data
  • Restricted access to user sessions
  • Explicit policy against using feedback for model training

Review full policies in the Commercial Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

🚀 Availability

  • Join the Claude Developers Discord for community support
  • Report issues via /bug or GitHub
  • Consult the setup documentation for troubleshooting
